newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul shares at record close at 1,194 points.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul shares at record close at 1,194 points.

text.p: Istanbul shares posted selective gains on Friday, with the market index hitting its fourth consequtive high in the continuing uptrend.

The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed at an all-time high of 1,194, up 14 points, or 1.19 percent from Thursday's previous record of 1,180. In dollar terms, it rose slightly to 1.06 cents from yesterday's record of 1.05 cents.
